<description>
Sending wtxidrelay twice before verack must not increment `m_wtxid_relay_peers` twice, otherwise the consistency check in `FinalizeNode` fails. This PR adds a test case for it as well as it kills the following mutant (https://mutanthub.space/mutants/3756):

```diff
--- a/src/net_processing.cpp
+++ b/src/net_processing.cpp
@@ -4200,4 +4200,5 @@
-        if (pfrom.GetCommonVersion() >= WTXID_RELAY_VERSION) {
-            if (!peer.m_wtxid_relay) {
-                peer.m_wtxid_relay = true;
-                m_wtxid_relay_peers++;
+        if (pfrom.GetCommonVersion() >= WTXID_RELAY_VERSION) {
+            m_wtxid_relay_peers++;
+            if (!peer.m_wtxid_relay) {
+                peer.m_wtxid_relay = true;
+
```

This test case basically connects an inbound peer and sends its version message, but not verack yet. Sends `wtxidrelay` twice. The second one should be ignored as a duplicate, and the test checks the peer isn't disconnected. And then, calls `FinalizeNode`. When the last peer is removed, `PeerManagerImpl` checks that `m_wtxid_relay_peers == 0`.
</description>
